summary: Seagate Technology Holdings plc filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of its 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2028. The company exchanged $185.908 million principal amount of notes for $185.908 million in cash plus an undetermined number of ordinary shares based on a one-trading-day volume-weighted average price starting May 21, 2026. The exchange is expected to close on May 26, 2026. This represents a hybrid cash-and-stock capital return to noteholders, effectively retiring debt with equity and cash. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The structure reduces debt overhang and potential dilution. Watch for the final share count and any impact on STX's capital structure.
